question: Where was the Fifth Global Standards Symposium (GSS-24) held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Fifth Global Standards Symposium** (GSS-24) was **inaugurated by Mr. Jyotiraditya M. Scindia**, Minister of Communications and Development of North Eastern Region, at the Bharat Mandapam, **New Delhi** marking a historic event for the Asia-Pacific region.1
 
• The theme for GSS-24 was “**Charting the Next Digital Wave**: Emerging Technologies, Innovation, and International Standards”.
 
• ITU, **established in 1865,** is the oldest UN-specialized agency for Information and Communication Technologies.
 
• The focus was on the role of international standards in **advancing emerging digital technologies and fostering sustainable developmen**t.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Global Standards Symposium (GSS)** is an important platform established for discussions and coordination in the field of international standards.
 
• Its main objective is to bring together global policymakers, innovators, and decision-makers to foster cooperation in the field of standards.
